title: Launcher local HTTP fixtures can reset metadata and confirmation requests during helper tests
outcome: Five existing launcher-helper behaviors failed with native localhost ECONNRESET on the unchanged current-master baseline before any fixture-speed work. Isolate the fixture transport so these cases remain meaningful without changing the product's retry/deadline policy, assertions, skips or execution isolation. Preserve the original failure and distinguish runtime observations from any unproved historical cause.
acceptance: The local HTTP fixtures in the launcher-helper tests (the five cases that reset on Central baseline test-7fdb7f8f) use a transport that cannot reuse a pooled keep-alive socket across synchronous Git or owner work, for example Connection: close on the fixture server or client. Every existing assertion, the injected-reset behavior, and the product's retry and deadline policy stay unchanged. There are no skips, retries, timeout changes, or new isolation-weakening concurrency.

The record keeps the original failure (test-7fdb7f8f, 516/5/2 with its retained logs) and the diagnostic pass (test-6a61217a, 5/0/0). It states what is proven, namely that the hardened transport removes the resets in a focused run, and what is not proven, namely the historical causality and any order-dependent mock behavior.

The affected launcher-helper files pass in a focused run on the exact candidate. The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding, and the full gate passes on the exact committed input.
